title: Marlowe & Finch Unlimited Status Credit toward Marlowe Rewards Tiers
content:
Members who hold a Marlowe & Finch Unlimited plan in force receive a status credit toward their Marlowe Rewards tier.

## The status credit

| Unlimited plan held by the member | Plan status | Status credit |
|---|---|---|
| An annual plan: Unlimited Student Annual, Unlimited Standard Annual, Unlimited Express Annual or Unlimited Next-Day Annual | active or cancellation pending | 10 percent |
| A monthly plan: Unlimited Standard Monthly or Unlimited Express Monthly | active or cancellation pending | 5 percent |
| Any other position: no plan, or a plan in trial, past due or expired | any | none |

## What the percentage applies to

The status credit applies to the window spend after the deduction: the qualifying spend counted, less the reversed spend deducted. That spend is multiplied once by one plus the status credit rate.

## Illustration (hypothetical window spend after the deduction of 1400.00)

| Member's plan | Spend with the status credit |
|---|---|
| Unlimited Next-Day Annual, active | 1540.00 |
| Unlimited Standard Monthly, cancellation pending | 1470.00 |
| Unlimited Express Annual, expired | 1400.00 |
